verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents collections with multiple requests and nested subfolders, kept for future reference and reusable "with a single click." The CLI can also rerun whole collections, with JUnit reporting. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the collection/folder organize-and-rerun workflow (community feedback covers only workspace and offline limits, not this flow).

support.subject: As a developer, I can organize API requests into collections and folders and rerun them anytime

citations.quote: Keep your API requests organized with collections and folders. Reuse them with a single click.
You can add multiple requests to a collection and even create subfolders inside a collection to further organize your requests.
You can organize your requests categorically for future reference or collaboration with your team using collections.
The hopp test command now has the ability to generate a JUnit Report for collection runs in the CLI.
